_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 85: 17-22 June 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He names Perry Stone, Joseph Z and other pastors appearing together, says they said they had a senator, that this is what the Lord told them and he has been saying it for years since 2022, that he came on the internet and started telling everyone what was coming, and that it is now being verified by other ministers.
mentions.quote: I've been saying this for years since 2022
mentions.falsify_match: Recordings from 2022 carrying the claim he says he has been making.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such recordings, or they say something else. Other ministers saying the same thing is agreement, not verification, and the two are being treated as one here.

mentions.claim_text: He tells new believers to say they are going to church and cannot go partying, to invite their friends who may say they do not want Jesus right now, to get some new friends but keep inviting the old ones because they will see the change, that they will see the glory on them as they press in, and to read their Bible every day.
mentions.quote: They're going to see the glory on you as you press in
mentions.condition_text: if you press in and read daily
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a visible change with no stated measure.

mentions.claim_text: He says there will always be a supply and it may not be the abundance you want at that time but it will get you through, and recounts times when they did not have much and his grandmother rang not knowing they had no food that night, saying she felt to order the children a pizza, and that they felt as though they had won the lottery.
mentions.quote: there will always be a supply
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: enough to get through is defined after the fact.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a. The hedge is stated openly and honestly, that it may not be the abundance you want, which is more candid than most of the provision material in this corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He says they do not care what he says and will do what they want, that he said to pray for this man's life, asks whether he should even say it publicly again, that this is what he saw they tried to do to him in the days ahead and that he was standing outside, and notes that Hezbollah has just launched a large missile attack in northern Israel, saying he saw an attack.
mentions.quote: Hezbollah just launched a large missile attack in northern Israel
mentions.falsify_match: A major attack on Israel matching what he described.
mentions.falsify_miss: None on a date. The passage cuts off mid-claim and he interrupts himself to ask whether he should say it publicly, so what he saw is not actually stated here.

mentions.claim_text: He notes the FBI director saying they just averted a major mass casualty event, that it was on X and the news people were talking about it, and that the Lord said to watch from his birthday on into the 4th of July because there are many more planned things like this concerning the water.
mentions.quote: watch from his birthday on into the 4th of July
mentions.time_phrase: his birthday into the 4th of July
mentions.falsify_match: Further plots against water supplies or gatherings in that three-week window.
mentions.falsify_miss: The window passes without one, which is what happened. Now past due and properly scoreable: both ends are fixed dates and the target, the water, is named.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw that they would interfere with the 911 communications, that he saw specifically about cell phones and cell phone towers and AT&T and that you could not call because they were overloaded with some kind of attack, that he saw SIM cards like the ones busted on September the 23rd of 2025, and that the Lord said to pray over 911.
mentions.quote: I saw that they would interfere with the 911 communications
mentions.falsify_match: The word predating the 23 September SIM farm seizure.
mentions.falsify_miss: It postdates it. This turns entirely on whether the cell tower and AT&T material was said before September 2025, which is checkable inside this corpus and should be pinned in the evidence pass.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw red and to pray over this area and then Fenway Park, believing it is Fenway where the Boston Red Sox play, that he sees so many different things and does not want to get them confused, and tells them to pray over parades and major gatherings for parades and firework displays for the 250th anniversary.
mentions.quote: Pray over parades. Pray over major gatherings for parades
mentions.falsify_match: An attack at a named ballpark or an anniversary parade.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing happens, which is what happened. A named venue is unusually specific for this corpus, though he hedges the identification himself, saying he believes it is Fenway and that he sees so many things he does not want to confuse them.

mentions.claim_text: He describes very sophisticated tech and says it was very serious, that the Lord said to watch concerning this over a hundred thousand SIM cards, that it was a multi-million dollar operation, that the Lord said there is more of it and they are not done, that this was back in September, and asks them to remember Timothy McVeigh.
mentions.quote: Watch concerning this over a 100,000 SIM cards
mentions.falsify_match: Further SIM farm seizures after the September one.
mentions.falsify_miss: There are none. The hundred thousand figure comes from the reported seizure rather than from the vision; what he adds is that there is more and they are not done, which is the part to score.

mentions.claim_text: He speaks of taking no counsel from the ungodly and praying over his decisions, says it is midterm and he is getting desperate as they get closer to the midterms and these elections are very serious, and says here are the two bozos just as the Lord warned him that Macron and Zelensky will be friends, with Macron being a puppet master to Zelensky, describing his nose growing.
mentions.quote: Mcronone and Zalinski will be friends
mentions.falsify_match: Macron and Zelensky appearing together as close allies.
mentions.falsify_miss: The fulfilment is a photograph of two wartime allies meeting, which is their ordinary working relationship. The claim as worded, that they will be friends, was met before it was made.

mentions.claim_text: He says there are plans to bring forth the digital one world order, digital ID and digital social credit scores and all the things they want to do in the days ahead, that the Lord said he is the log in the road for right now, and that the Lord said they will be so thankful they had him in the days ahead because with Kamala Harris they would be in trouble and would already be going down this path.
mentions.quote: you'll be so thankful that you had him in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: Digital ID and social credit systems arriving once the obstacle is removed.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The counterfactual about the other candidate cannot be tested at all, and it does the work of making the present administration's failures irrelevant to the claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says they were doing slush funds and doing very bad things with the money given to them as aid, that it was very bad, that he keeps seeing it and the Lord keeps warning, breaks off to turn something on, and asks what he was saying, being reminded it was about President Trump on the 14th and that they busted it.
mentions.quote: doing slush funds and they were and and doing things very bad
mentions.falsify_match: Documented misuse of aid money through slush funds.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. No country, agency, sum or date is given, so nothing here identifies what would be checked.

mentions.claim_text: He says it encouraged him that the FBI had it together and they stopped these people from trying to cause mass casualties with snipers and drones aiming to hurt people at President Trump's birthday party, gives all glory to Jesus, and then reads a headline about 911 problems reported in several states on June 16th 2026, which he establishes is today.
mentions.quote: we stopped these idiots from trying to uh cause mass casualties with snipers
mentions.falsify_match: The reported plot and the emergency line failures matching what he said in advance.
mentions.falsify_miss: The prior word does not match. Two separate news items are joined here, a foiled plot and 911 outages on the same day, and both are offered against the same forecast. The outages are also the closest thing in the corpus to a live test of the 911 claim, so this one is worth pursuing properly.
